what.text: This page follows refugees from Sudan living in the Netherlands, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1442 Sudanese refugees in the Netherlands, 0.1% of all refugees from Sudan.
Chad hosts the most Sudanese refugees, followed by South Sudan, Libya and Ethiopia.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Sudan in periods from 1987 to 2025, with the RSF among the opponents since 2020.
It also records an interstate armed conflict between South Sudan and Sudan in 2012.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1992 at 43 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 3810, at the end of 2006; the main years of displacement in the data are 1998 to 2009.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the Netherlands.
These are year-end totals for the Netherlands only, reported to UNHCR.
